This article lists '''European countries by fossil fuel use''', using the percentage of total energy.
== Map ==

The map data is from year 2022, where data is available, from the World Bank.<ref>{{cite web|title=Fossil fuel energy consumption (% of total) |url=http://data.worldbank.org/indicator/EG.USE.COMM.FO.ZS/countries|website=The World Bank|accessdate=11 August 2015}}</ref> Numbers are in percentage.
